findings.claim: For the quarter ended September 30, 2026, Brookfield reported consolidated net income of $1.914 billion versus $284 million a year earlier, net income attributable to shareholders of $1.305 billion versus $219 million, and distributable earnings of $1.718 billion, or $0.73 per share, up 16% per share from $0.63.
findings.source_title: Brookfield Corporation Reports 16% Increase in Earnings

findings.claim: Distributable earnings before realizations were a record $5.815 billion, or $2.47 per share, over the twelve months ended September 30, 2026, and fee-related earnings rose 15% from the prior-year quarter as fee-bearing capital increased 13% to $682 billion.
findings.source_title: Brookfield Corporation Reports 16% Increase in Earnings

findings.claim: Fundraising through the third quarter of 2026 totaled $123 billion, including $25 billion in the quarter, and after quarter-end Brookfield received $13 billion of additional commitments for its infrastructure flagship, taking capital committed to $26 billion, with a first close expected in the coming weeks.
findings.source_title: Brookfield Corporation Reports 16% Increase in Earnings

findings.claim: Wealth Solutions distributable earnings rose 22% from the prior-year quarter to $511 million, insurance assets were nearly $200 billion after the Just Group acquisition, and the P&C combined ratio was 99.6% in the quarter.
findings.source_title: Brookfield Corporation Reports 16% Increase in Earnings

findings.claim: Closing of the Just Group acquisition added $45 billion of insurance assets and took Wealth Solutions insurance assets to $191 billion as of June 30, 2026.
findings.source_title: Brookfield Corporation interim report for the quarter ended June 30, 2026

findings.claim: Brookfield ended the quarter with $207 billion of deployable capital, including $5.4 billion of liquidity at the Corporation, and said corporate debt had a 14-year weighted-average term with no remaining maturities in 2026; it also issued $600 million of five-year senior notes at 82 basis points over the benchmark.
findings.source_title: Brookfield Corporation Reports 16% Increase in Earnings

findings.claim: Brookfield repurchased over $300 million of Class A shares since the prior report and $889 million year to date, and the weighted-average share count for the quarter was 2,230.9 million versus 2,244.0 million a year earlier.
findings.source_title: Brookfield Corporation Reports 16% Increase in Earnings

findings.claim: At September 30, 2026, corporate borrowings were $16.056 billion, up from $14.301 billion at December 31, 2025, and non-recourse borrowings of managed entities were $266.013 billion, up from $245.311 billion.
findings.source_title: Brookfield Corporation Reports 16% Increase in Earnings

findings.claim: Interest expense on same-store non-recourse borrowings was $4.199 billion in the third quarter of 2026, and interest on corporate borrowings was $198 million.
findings.source_title: Brookfield Corporation Reports 16% Increase in Earnings

findings.claim: Distributable earnings from Brookfield Property Group were $727 million over the twelve months ended September 30, 2026, down from $853 million in the prior twelve-month period, and the corporate-costs-and-other drag widened to $237 million in the quarter from $140 million a year earlier.
findings.source_title: Brookfield Corporation Reports 16% Increase in Earnings

findings.claim: Real Estate common equity rose to $26.7 billion at June 30, 2026 from $25.1 billion at year-end 2025, but the increase was partly offset by lower valuations on certain U.S. office properties in the value-add portfolio.
findings.source_title: Brookfield Corporation interim report for the quarter ended June 30, 2026

findings.claim: Common equity was $42.991 billion at September 30, 2026, against $128.415 billion of non-controlling interests and $4.086 billion of preferred equity, so public common shareholders are a minority of the consolidated equity stack.
findings.source_title: Brookfield Corporation Reports 16% Increase in Earnings

findings.claim: Diluted earnings per share for the quarter were $0.54 on 2,346.9 million shares and equivalents, including a 116.0 million dilutive effect from options, escrowed shares and exchangeable shares of an affiliate.
findings.source_title: Brookfield Corporation Reports 16% Increase in Earnings

findings.claim: Brookfield expects to complete the combination with Brookfield Wealth Solutions on December 1, 2026, with Class A shares of Brookfield Corporation Ltd. expected to trade as BN on December 3; the dividend reinvestment plan terminates on November 17, and eligible Canadian and UK holders must elect tax deferral by November 25.
findings.source_title: Brookfield Corporation Reports 16% Increase in Earnings

findings.claim: In July 2026 Brookfield completed the acquisition of the remaining interest in Oaktree, and the Q2 shareholder letter said shareholders had approved the corporate simplification.
findings.source_title: Brookfield Corporation interim report for the quarter ended June 30, 2026

findings.claim: During the third quarter Brookfield leased 5.3 million square feet of office and retail space, with net rents on the balance-sheet office portfolio 16% above expiring leases, and it advanced $20 billion of asset sales in the quarter and $53 billion year to date.
findings.source_title: Brookfield Corporation Reports 16% Increase in Earnings

findings.claim: Brookfield said its energy business is advancing nuclear work through Westinghouse, including a recently announced framework agreement among Westinghouse, the U.S. federal government and Korea to accelerate U.S. nuclear development.
findings.source_title: Brookfield Corporation Reports 16% Increase in Earnings

findings.claim: On November 23, 2026 Brookfield agreed to acquire PGP Glass from Blackstone funds for $1.7 billion through its flagship private equity strategy and Brookfield Business Corporation; PGP has 13 furnaces with over 1,800 tonnes per day of capacity in India and Sri Lanka, and closing is expected in Q1 2027 subject to regulatory approvals.
findings.source_title: Brookfield to Acquire PGP Glass, a Leading Global Manufacturer of Specialty Glass Packaging from Blackstone for $1.7 billion

findings.claim: On November 20, 2026 Qatar Investment Authority and Brookfield Corporation signed a memorandum of understanding to explore investments in Germany's critical industries and defense sector, aiming for a combined EUR 15 billion; the MoU is non-binding and names no specific deals.
findings.source_title: QIA and Brookfield Announce Initiative to Invest in Germany's Critical Industries

findings.claim: On November 9, 2026 Brookfield and its institutional partners agreed to sell a 50% interest in Enercare to PSP Investments for about C$1.6 billion, with closing expected in the first half of 2027 subject to regulatory approvals.
findings.source_title: Brookfield to sell 50% interest in Enercare to PSP Investments

policy_links.policy: Framework agreement among Westinghouse, the U.S. federal government and Korea to accelerate nuclear development in the United States
policy_links.revenue_mechanism: Brookfield said the agreement strengthens the outlook for its Westinghouse energy business, but the release did not disclose a contract value or booked revenue.

policy_links.policy: German prioritization of critical industries and defense production capacity, which QIA and Brookfield cite as the basis for a EUR 15 billion co-investment MoU
policy_links.bottleneck: Domestic production capacity for defense and critical industries
policy_links.revenue_mechanism: Brookfield would earn fees and returns on capital deployed into German industrial and defense businesses, but the MoU is exploratory and no investment or revenue has been announced.

key_risks.risk: Non-recourse borrowings of managed entities were $266.0 billion at September 30, 2026, and same-store interest on that debt was $4.2 billion in the quarter. The debt is largely non-recourse and corporate maturities are clear through 2026, but asset-level leverage can still reduce cash available to the parent if rates stay high or asset values fall.

The December 1, 2026 combination folds the investment parent together with a wealth and insurance platform that already holds nearly $200 billion of insurance assets and earned a 99.6% P&C combined ratio in the third quarter, so insurance results will sit closer to the public share.
Property-group distributable earnings fell over the last twelve months, and the Q2 report cited lower valuations on certain U.S. office properties in the value-add portfolio.

Options, escrowed shares and affiliate exchangeable shares added 116.0 million shares to the diluted count, about 5% of the 2,230.9 million weighted-average shares, even while the company was repurchasing stock.

notes: Brookfield is a Canadian foreign private issuer and reports under IFRS on Form 6-K and Form 40-F, not a 10-Q. The Q3 2026 figures are from the November 12, 2026 earnings release; the corresponding 6-K was not yet on EDGAR at the time of this write-up, and the release says the figures are unaudited. No equity offering, ATM or new convertible issuance was found in the last twelve months; the share count fell with buybacks, while 116 million existing options and exchangeable shares remain dilutive. Per-share figures in the release are adjusted for the three-for-two split completed on October 9, 2025, which is just outside the twelve-month window. The Westinghouse framework is described only in Brookfield's release, with no contract value, so evidence_of_company_revenue is false. Gross accumulated unrealized carried interest was $13.0 billion at quarter end; that balance is not included above as realized earnings. November 25, 2026 refresh: added the PGP Glass acquisition (announced by Brookfield Asset Management and funded by the private equity strategy and BBUC, so BN's exposure is indirect), the non-binding QIA Germany MoU, and the Enercare stake sale, which is sourced to the advising law firm's deal page rather than a Brookfield release. Brookfield Wealth Solutions' November 12 release on EDGAR repeats the December 1 closing and December 3 BN trading dates; no delay notice was found as of this refresh.
